description: Anonymized CFB curb-mode correctness regression for robust pre-snap, noding, holes, and source-coordinate fidelity.
reason: Accepted after the #798 correctness audit. Shapely 2.1.2/GEOS 3.13.1 with 0.5 snap yields 1261 raw polygons; filtering faces with area <= 0.1 yields 1253 polygons and area 8797786.546790. Rust yields the same accepted count and area 8797796.791456 with Jaccard 0.9999980263. The dominant delta follows source edge-of-pavement linework, while the Shapely shortcut departs from it by up to 0.144516.
